name: Identity & Memory
description: An AI identity shaped by your communication style, business knowledge and relevant customer context.

features.name: Identity & Personality
features.description: Configure tone, vocabulary, communication preferences and behavioural boundaries using approved examples.
features.controls: Review examples and boundaries before enabling customer-facing use.

features.name: Business Knowledge
features.description: Retrieve relevant information from approved documents, products, policies and operating procedures.
features.controls: Keep sources current and restrict retrieval to authorised documents.

features.name: Persistent Memory
features.description: Retain relevant preferences, decisions and unresolved requests to support continuity between conversations.
features.controls: Save selected facts with source and access boundaries, not indiscriminate transcripts.

features.name: Relationship Context
features.description: Bring together relevant history, current needs and outstanding commitments for an individual customer.
features.controls: Confirm identity before joining context across channels.

features.name: Memory Management
features.description: Review, correct and control saved information, including its source and permitted use.
features.controls: Define retention and deletion arrangements for the implementation.

name: Voice Cloning & Communication
description: Consistent, personalised communication through contextual conversations and an authorised cloned voice.

features.name: Voice Cloning
features.description: Configure an authorised voice identity for generated speech, with approved samples and usage controls.
features.controls: Requires the voice owner’s permission and approved recordings. No cloned audio sample is connected to this preview.

features.name: Conversational Intelligence
features.description: Interpret requests and manage multi-step conversations in the configured communication style.
features.controls: Use approved knowledge and escalate requests outside the configured scope.

features.name: Personalised Voice Messages
features.description: Deliver spoken responses informed by the conversation and relevant available information.
features.controls: Requires authorised voice configuration and a supported delivery channel.

features.name: Speech Interaction
features.description: Support spoken requests and audio responses where the selected interface and deployment allow them.
features.controls: Microphone access is opt-in. Speech-provider processing must be disclosed.

features.name: Human Handover
features.description: Transfer relevant history and unresolved questions to an operator while pausing automated responses.
features.controls: Automation must remain paused until an authorised operator resumes it.

name: Business Automation
description: Coordinate routine work across connected systems, with defined triggers, approval rules and operational visibility.

features.name: Workflow Orchestration
features.description: Coordinate multi-step processes, conditions, approvals and exceptions across connected software.
features.controls: Apply approvals, duplicate-operation protection and exception handling.

features.name: Email Automation
features.description: Identify messages requiring attention, prepare contextual responses and manage approved email workflows.
features.controls: Requires a supported mailbox connection. Sending scope and approval are configured separately.

features.name: Calendar & Task Automation
features.description: Coordinate appointments, reminders, assignments and outstanding commitments.
features.controls: Check availability and time zones before committing appointments.

features.name: Document & Data Automation
features.description: Extract information, prepare documents and update records through validation and review.
features.controls: Validate required fields and request human review where information is uncertain.

features.name: Automated Briefings & Reporting
features.description: Assemble scheduled summaries of priorities, unresolved work, business changes and exceptions.
features.controls: Retain source context and show freshness. Missing information is not a zero.

name: Sales & Customer Automation
description: Manage the customer journey from first enquiry through conversion, delivery and ongoing engagement.

features.name: Lead Qualification & Routing
features.description: Capture requirements, apply qualification criteria and route enquiries to the appropriate person or workflow.
features.controls: Use business-approved criteria and retain a clear human escalation route.

features.name: Nurturing & Follow-Up Automation
features.description: Continue relevant conversations using customer context, timing rules and clear stopping conditions.
features.controls: Respect opt-outs and channel rules. Pause on replies, purchases or human takeover as configured.

features.name: Pipeline Intelligence
features.description: Surface stalled opportunities, missing information and potential next steps using connected deal records.
features.controls: Requires a supported CRM connection. Recommendations are not guaranteed sales predictions.

features.name: Customer Lifecycle Automation
features.description: Coordinate progress updates, delivery communication, aftercare and appropriate review or referral requests.
features.controls: Do not invent a delivery status or promise. Use verified operational records.

features.name: Re-engagement & Retention
features.description: Reconnect with eligible inactive leads or customers using previous interests and relationship context.
features.controls: Apply consent, suppression and frequency controls before contacting anyone.

name: CRM & Integrations
description: Explore customer relationship workflows and potential connections between Construction Intelligence and the systems your business already uses.

features.name: CRM Workspace
features.description: Customer or fan records, conversation history, notes and the information required to manage each relationship.
features.controls: Keep channel identities and permissions explicit. Available workflows depend on connected systems.

features.name: Content & Commerce
features.description: Approved media, offers, bundles, pricing and purchase or delivery records for supported use cases.
features.controls: Verify ownership, permitted channels, pricing and delivery status before offering content.

features.name: Revenue & Performance
features.description: Sales visibility, conversion reporting and performance analysis with clear definitions and channel breakdowns.
features.controls: Preserve source currencies, fees and refunds. Do not merge incompatible conversion populations.

features.name: Team Collaboration
features.description: Operator assignments, shared workflows, human oversight and access appropriate to each team member.
features.controls: Team workflows and permissions are configured for the implementation.

features.name: System Integrations
features.description: Supported connections to CRMs, email, calendars, messaging platforms and databases through connectors, APIs and webhooks.
features.controls: Connector availability and read/write scope are verified during implementation, not assumed.

name: Private Intelligence
description: Deployment and governance options designed around how your organisation stores, accesses and processes information.

features.name: Deployment Options
features.description: Dedicated or customer-controlled environments scoped to an organisation’s requirements.
features.controls: Custom deployment. Customer-controlled hosting does not automatically eliminate external processing.

features.name: Access & Permissions
features.description: Define which users, services and support personnel may access information or perform permitted operations.
features.controls: Specify support access, approval, time limits and revocation for the deployment.

features.name: Data & Memory Boundaries
features.description: Control separation between organisations, customer relationships, creators and communication channels.
features.controls: Identity verification and memory-sharing rules must be designed and tested.

features.name: Approval & Audit Controls
features.description: Establish review requirements and maintain records of permitted operations, access and changes.
features.controls: Separate attempted work from successful delivery. Limit access to audit records.

features.name: Data Lifecycle Management
features.description: Define retention, export and deletion arrangements for business information and saved context.
features.controls: Include backups and provider retention when defining export and deletion arrangements.

features.name: AI Provider Controls
features.description: Identify approved model and voice providers, the information they process and applicable configuration.
features.controls: Specify approved providers, retention, processing locations and permitted data flows.
